risks: Root-owned wave0 changes can invalidate source bytes; input revision is lineage, not a claim of unchanged working tree. No Git state was changed or inspected by this worker.
Task domain newFiles overlap WP-13 exactly; concurrent file creation/overwrites or duplicate task tables would violate dependency acceptance and one authority.

Published completeOccurrence versus task.complete names and supplemental preview/read/update/snooze contracts need accepted mapping; implementing only the one detailed operation would silently narrow full DoD.
Recurrence timezone cannot safely be inferred from bare numeric historical timestamps. Quarantine unresolved data with provenance instead of pretending migration certainty.

Existing fixed recurrence skips missed task dates, while scheduler must replay missed jobs; distinguish next eligible task calculation from delivery recovery. Replay must not manufacture every skipped past task.

Host-local Date calendar arithmetic is not itself a UTC-duration bug; preserve its local semantics but explicit series-zone calculations and DST reminder offsets are still missing. JS month rollover and 1000-step guard require declared policy and coverage.

Clearing recurrence in an in-memory completed copy is not transactional idempotency across two devices, lost reply or different command IDs; standalone per-file payload idempotency is not occurrence uniqueness.
Completing a cancelled task currently clears cancellation; without explicit lifecycle fences cancelled/trashed series can produce next tasks or due reminders.

No worker entrypoint is named among normative files; commands/repository alone cannot execute reminders. Composition root must actually schedule/reclaim jobs, with lease fencing and current policy recheck.
Task handler comment claims LOCAL_ONLY while protocol routes personalTasks as REMOTE_ELIGIBLE; neither config-root storage nor workspace transport string proves authenticated shared tenancy.
TaskLink.label/source and copied notes/links can leak source metadata through next task, reminder, hover, notifications or agent context if current source authorization is skipped.
SH-18 introduces WP-40 routing prerequisite; COL-16 names WP-05/WP-37 mechanisms not present in explicit WP-14 dependency array. These are integration gates, not silently invented DAG edits.

Current TaskDetail onToggleComplete has no receipt and parent mutation wiring is outside scoped inspection; integration owner must stop shared local spawning on every caller, not only detail checkbox.
Full feature completeness includes search/mentions/sharing/activity/agent/API, not merely completion scheduler test; absent consumer APIs remain missing prerequisites, never N/A.
